items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 重新审视运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学洞见
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了267例运动神经元病患者，发现75%存在体感诱发电位异常，且上下运动神经元表型间无差异。N20-P25波幅增高在两种表型中均可见，提示感觉皮层高兴奋性，而运动诱发电位异常主要见于上运动神经元表型。体感诱发电位异常与运动诱发电位结果无显著关联，支持MND为累及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病。
items.insight: 该研究以较大样本量重新审视了长期被忽视的体感诱发电位在MND中的意义，提出感觉皮层高兴奋性可能是独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍的普遍特征。这为将MND理解为多系统网络疾病提供了神经生理学证据，并提示体感诱发电位可能作为辅助诊断工具，值得在ALS生物标志物和病理生理机制研究中进一步跟踪。

items.abstractZh: 系统性地研究大型运动神经元病（MND）患者队列中的体感诱发电位（SEP）异常，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEP）及临床表型的关系。我们回顾性分析了267例确诊MND患者，这些患者接受了标准化的SEP和经颅磁刺激检查。患者被分为纯/以上运动神经元（UMN）为主组和纯/以下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）为主组。SEP异常通过内部正常参考数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低以及N20-P25波幅增高。MEP由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。75%的患者检测到至少一项SEP异常，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增高，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的感觉皮层高兴奋性。相比之下，异常MEP在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP结果之间未发现显著关联。上肢与下肢SEP潜伏期高度相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增高与潜伏期异常不相关。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且似乎与皮质脊髓功能障碍基本无关。SEP波幅增高可能反映原发性皮层感觉高兴奋性，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND作为一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并凸显了SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于267例MND患者的新近大样本神经生理学数据，揭示了感觉皮层高兴奋性这一与ALS多系统网络病理相关的新视角，并提示体感诱发电位在诊断评估中的潜在转化价值。

items.title: Identifying candidate therapeutic targets in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through a transcriptome-wide machine-learning consensus approach for drug repurposing.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease for which effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. This study aimed to derive internally recurrent ALS-associated transcriptional signatures and generate directionally interpretable drug-repositioning hypotheses using a consensus machine-learning framework. Two publicly available transcriptomic datasets from motor cortex (E-MTAB-2325) and blood (E-TABM-940) were analyzed using four feature-selection methods within 100 repetitions of 4-fold cross-validation. Probes recurrently selected in models achieving an accuracy of at least 0.90 were prioritized and examined using COGENA pathway enrichment and Connectivity Map drug-signature analysis. Fifteen qualifying models were obtained for the motor-cortex dataset and 55 for the blood dataset. No exact prioritized gene or probe identifier was shared between the two top-100 signatures, but pathway-level integration identified complementary evidence involving glial and immune regulation, proteostasis and vesicle trafficking, MAPK-related stress signaling, cytoskeletal and extracellular remodeling, and RNA-related processes. The motor-cortex dataset additionally emphasized astroglial support, glutamate handling, and inclusion-body regulation, whereas the blood dataset highlighted cytokine regulation and directionally heterogeneous immune, mitochondrial, and metabolic signals. Deferoxamine and disulfiram showed the clearest reversal-compatible profiles in motor cortex, whereas yohimbic acid and atovaquone showed reversal-compatible profiles in blood. Ciprofloxacin, prochlorperazine, and a compound group led by androsterone instead showed concordant connectivity. The results provide transparent, hypothesis-generating gene, pathway, and compound priorities, but they do not establish biomarkers, therapeutic efficacy, or clinical suitability and require validation in independent cohorts and experimental ALS models.
items.titleZh: 通过转录组范围机器学习共识方法识别肌萎缩侧索硬化候选治疗靶点以用于药物重定位
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用机器学习共识框架分析ALS运动皮层和血液转录组数据，识别出可重复的转录特征和候选药物重定位假设。两个数据集在基因层面无重叠，但通路层面均涉及胶质免疫调节、蛋白稳态、MAPK信号等。运动皮层提示去铁胺和双硫仑，血液提示育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌具有反向兼容特征。结果仅为假设生成，未验证疗效或临床适用性。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS药物重定位提供了基于转录组共识的候选靶点和化合物优先级，尽管尚属假设生成阶段，但其整合多数据集和通路层面的方法有助于揭示ALS异质性背后的共享机制，并为后续实验验证提供方向。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法仍然有限。本研究旨在利用共识机器学习框架，推导内部可重复的ALS相关转录特征，并生成方向可解释的药物重定位假设。研究分析了两个公开转录组数据集，分别来自运动皮层（E-MTAB-2325）和血液（E-TABM-940），在100次重复的4折交叉验证中使用了四种特征选择方法。在准确率至少达到0.90的模型中反复被选中的探针被优先考虑，并通过COGENA通路富集和Connectivity Map药物特征分析进行检查。运动皮层数据集获得了15个合格模型，血液数据集获得了55个合格模型。两个前100特征之间没有共享完全相同的优先基因或探针标识符，但通路层面的整合识别出涉及胶质和免疫调节、蛋白稳态和囊泡运输、MAPK相关应激信号、细胞骨架和细胞外重塑以及RNA相关过程的互补证据。运动皮层数据集还强调了星形胶质细胞支持、谷氨酸处理和包涵体调节，而血液数据集则突出了细胞因子调节以及方向异质性的免疫、线粒体和代谢信号。去铁胺和双硫仑在运动皮层中显示出最清晰的反向兼容特征，而育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌在血液中显示出反向兼容特征。环丙沙星、丙氯拉嗪以及以雄酮为首的化合物组则显示出同向连接性。这些结果提供了透明的、产生假设的基因、通路和化合物优先级，但并未建立生物标志物、治疗疗效或临床适用性，需要在独立队列和实验性ALS模型中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，利用机器学习共识方法整合ALS转录组数据生成药物重定位假设，具有转化潜力但需实验验证。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.

items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，指出ALS早期和中期临床试验常被用来宣称疗效，但这些结果大多未能在3期试验中兑现，形成了“可信度差距”。作者认为，产业界与学术界错位的激励催生了多种反复出现的科学推理谬误，包括错误前提下的结局比较、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签数据，以及对不确定结果的过度乐观解读。文章呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的分流，以推动真正有效的ALS疗法开发。
items.insight: 这篇观点文章直指ALS临床试验生态中的系统性问题，对研究者、申办方和监管者都有警示意义。它提醒ALS领域：在生物标志物（如NfL）和早期试验数据被频繁用于支持疗效宣称的当下，必须更严格地区分假设生成与假设检验，避免过早将不确定信号包装为治疗希望。对跟踪ALS疗法转化的人来说，这是一份关于如何解读早期试验结果、如何设计2期分流标准的重要方法学参考。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个极大影响试验设计、数据解读和结果传播的“临床试验工业综合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与所述目标之间的不匹配、结局的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既有的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，针对ALS临床试验中长期存在的早期数据过度解读问题提出系统性批评与改革呼吁，对当前ALS疗法转化和试验设计具有直接的方法学与转化价值。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.
items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒治疗神经退行性疾病：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药来源生物活性成分（如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素、EGCG）通过纳米递送系统治疗阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和ALS等神经退行性疾病的研究进展。文章重点讨论了纳米载体如何改善这些成分的水溶性、口服生物利用度和血脑屏障穿透能力，并覆盖了疾病特异性分子靶点、纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管挑战及仿生纳米颗粒、细胞外囊泡等新兴技术。作者明确指出，尽管临床前结果积极，但目前尚无任何草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证实明确疗效或获得监管批准，临床证据仍然有限。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于它把草药纳米制剂这一相对边缘但快速发展的方向，放进了神经退行性疾病共同的病理框架（蛋白聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍）中审视。ALS治疗长期受限于血脑屏障穿透和靶向递送，而纳米载体策略可能为现有或新兴的ALS相关生物活性分子提供递送解决方案。同时，文章对纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性和监管路径的批判性讨论，有助于研究者在早期设计阶段就规避转化风险，而不是停留在临床前概念验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病临床前模型中显示出改善药代动力学和脑内递送的潜力，但尚无临床证据支持其明确疗效或监管批准。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，本文不提供原始实验数据；所引用的临床前结果多来自动物或细胞模型，向ALS患者转化仍存在标准化、安全性和监管层面的重大障碍。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征为进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管常规疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与既往综述不同，本文整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的既往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面且批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，网址为 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡等新兴递送技术，并直接讨论其在包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病中的转化障碍，对关注血脑屏障递送策略的ALS研究者具有参考价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 该文指出，ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增不仅是脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型的致病原因，也是 ALS 的重要风险因素。新报道的阿卡迪亚家族呈现隐性遗传模式，提示 ATXN2 相关疾病并非仅由显性功能获得机制驱动。重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量可能改变遗传模式，功能丧失机制在某些情境下也可能参与致病。文章强调，未来需对 ATXN2 相关疾病进行遗传分层，以指导分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略。
items.insight: ATXN2 是 ALS 领域少数同时具有明确遗传证据和可成药性的靶点之一。该文提示，ATXN2 相关疾病的遗传模式和致病机制可能比既往认为的更为异质，单纯以显性功能获得模型解释所有病例可能不足。对 ALS 研究者而言，这意味着在解读 ATXN2 变异、设计反义寡核苷酸等靶向治疗以及开展遗传咨询时，需要纳入重复序列结构、嵌合状态和基因剂量等因素，避免将特定机制过度推广至全部患者。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅由常染色体显性功能获得机制驱动，隐性遗传、重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量均可影响遗传模式，提示功能丧失机制在某些情境下参与致病。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为评论性文章，主要基于单个家系报道和机制推测，未提供大规模人群或功能实验验证，ATXN2 隐性遗传模式的普遍性尚不明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否出现更多 ATXN2 隐性遗传家系或队列研究，以及重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量对 ALS 表型和治疗反应的影响。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来关于主要为常染色体显性、功能获得驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能随重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下参与发病机制。我们讨论了其对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调需要进行遗传分层。
items.frontierRationale: 该文基于新近报道的 ATXN2 隐性遗传家系，重新审视 ATXN2 在 ALS 中的遗传机制异质性，对靶向治疗分层和遗传咨询具有直接转化意义。

items.title: Poor Prognostic Factors After Gastrostomy in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Two-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) is widely used to manage dysphagia in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, some patients experience rapid clinical deterioration following the procedure. Prognostic factors specific to outcomes following PEG remain insufficiently defined. This two-center retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with ALS who underwent PEG prior to tracheostomy between April 2011 and June 2023. Cox proportional hazards modeling was used to identify independent prognostic factors following PEG. Explanatory variables included age, sex, onset site, percent of normal forced vital capacity (%FVC), disease duration from onset to PEG, and body mass index. Optimal cutoff values for continuous variables were determined using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic analyses. Among six examined clinical variables, four were independently associated with worse outcomes after PEG placement as follows: male sex, spinal onset, lower %FVC at the time of PEG, and shorter duration from onset to PEG. Cutoff values were determined as %FVC < 63% and disease duration < 12 months. Log-rank analyses confirmed significantly shorter post-PEG survival in patients meeting these criteria. Poorer respiratory function and shorter duration from disease onset to PEG were strongly associated with worse prognosis after PEG. Male sex emerged as an independent prognostic factor, suggesting potential biological differences in disease progression after gastrostomy. These findings underscore the importance of comprehensive clinical evaluation when considering PEG in patients with ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者胃造瘘术后的不良预后因素：一项双中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项双中心回顾性队列研究分析了117例在气管切开前接受经皮内镜下胃造瘘术（PEG）的ALS患者，发现男性、脊髓起病、PEG时%FVC低于63%以及从起病至PEG病程短于12个月这四个因素与PEG术后更差的预后独立相关。研究提示，呼吸功能较差和病程较短的患者在PEG术后生存期更短，男性可能是独立的预后不良因素。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS患者PEG术后的预后分层提供了可操作的临床指标（%FVC < 63%、病程 < 12个月、男性、脊髓起病），有助于临床医生在考虑PEG时进行更全面的评估和个体化决策。同时，男性作为独立预后因素提示胃造瘘术后疾病进展可能存在生物学差异，值得进一步探索其潜在机制。

items.abstractZh: 经皮内镜下胃造瘘术（PEG）广泛用于管理肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的吞咽困难。然而，部分患者在术后出现快速临床恶化。针对PEG术后结局的特异性预后因素仍定义不足。这项双中心回顾性队列研究纳入了2011年4月至2023年6月期间在气管切开前接受PEG的117例ALS患者。采用Cox比例风险模型识别PEG术后的独立预后因素。解释变量包括年龄、性别、起病部位、用力肺活量占正常预计值的百分比（%FVC）、从起病至PEG的病程以及体重指数。连续变量的最佳截断值通过时间依赖性受试者工作特征分析确定。在六个考察的临床变量中，有四个与PEG置入后更差的结局独立相关，具体如下：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时较低的%FVC以及从起病至PEG较短的病程。截断值确定为%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月。Log-rank分析证实，符合这些标准的患者PEG术后生存期显著更短。较差的呼吸功能和从疾病起病至PEG较短的病程与PEG后更差的预后强烈相关。男性成为独立的预后因素，提示胃造瘘术后疾病进展可能存在生物学差异。这些发现强调了在考虑对ALS患者进行PEG时进行全面临床评估的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于新近的双中心队列数据，聚焦ALS患者胃造瘘术后的预后因素，为临床决策提供了可量化的风险分层指标，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过系统性文献综述结合计算机分析，梳理了与ALS相关的环状RNA，发现多个circRNA可调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等ALS相关通路，并可海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白。分子对接提示ALS相关FUS变异会改变其与circRNA的结合亲和力，ALS患者中枢神经系统RNA-seq数据也显示相关宿主基因和枢纽蛋白表达异常。研究提示circRNA可能参与ALS发病机制。
items.insight: 该研究将ALS中的非编码RNA视角从miRNA和lncRNA进一步拓展到环状RNA，并整合文献综述、计算机靶点分析、蛋白-RNA相互作用、分子对接和患者组织RNA-seq数据，提出circRNA可能通过调控ALS相关通路及海绵吸附RNA结合蛋白参与发病。尤其值得关注的是FUS变异可能改变其与circRNA的结合亲和力，这为FUS相关ALS的RNA代谢机制提供了新的可检验假设。后续需要实验验证具体circRNA的功能、因果方向及其作为生物标志物或治疗靶点的可行性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元进行性丢失为特征，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传学基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，尤其是环状RNA（circRNA）在疾病发生和进展中的参与。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元病（MND）有关的circRNA。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能。随后，我们展示了系统性文献综述，该综述识别了与ALS相关的circRNA，并对基于最有力ALS相关数据筛选出的15个环状RNA候选分子进行了计算机分析。我们的结果显示，若干环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，如未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡。蛋白-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNA可海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与环状RNA的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在受ALS影响的中枢神经系统组织中，ALS相关circRNA的宿主基因及枢纽蛋白表达发生显著改变。总体而言，我们的发现表明circRNA是ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合了环状RNA与ALS相关基因调控、FUS变异结合亲和力及患者中枢神经系统RNA-seq证据，为ALS中RNA代谢机制和潜在转化靶点提供了值得跟踪的新线索。

items.title: Retromer-targeted therapy for neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) are neurodegenerative diseases characterized by dysfunction of the endosomal-lysosomal system (ELS). Four shared neurodegenerative mechanisms across ALS, PD and AD are regulated by the ELS, namely proteostasis and related protein misfolding, mitochondrial function, neurotransmission and neuroinflammation. These mechanisms are interconnected, contributing to neurodegeneration in a "snowball" manner. The retromer, a multimeric, evolutionarily conserved protein complex involved in intracellular protein trafficking, is at the crossroad of these neurodegenerative processes. This narrative review focuses on exploring the retromer structure, function as a master regulator of the ELS, and how this impacts proteostasis, mitochondrial biogenesis and homeostasis, neurotransmission and neuroinflammation across neurodegenerative diseases. We explore how alterations in retromer function can play an important role in neurodegeneration and discuss the impact of genetic and pharmacological manipulations of VPS35, one of the main retromer subunits. In vitro and in vivo studies have identified that the retromer enhances the activity of protein degradation pathways via the ELS, namely macroautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, and the ELS itself, with concomitant reduction in misfolded protein levels. Also, in some model systems, when the retromer role is enhanced or restored, mitochondrial function is rescued, dysfunctional neurotransmission is restored, and the damaging effects of neuroinflammation are dampened. Lastly, we highlight the role of a novel pharmacological class of agents that enhance retromer function as a strategy for potentially slowing the progression of these neurodegenerative diseases in in vivo models of PD and ALS. We discuss the challenges in targeting the retromer, current limitations and potential off-target effects of retromer enhancement. Overall, the retromer regulates shared mechanisms across neurodegenerative diseases and retromer enhancers could represent a novel disease-modifying strategy in AD, PD and ALS.

items.titleZh: 靶向逆转录体的神经退行性疾病治疗
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述指出，阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和ALS共享内体-溶酶体系统功能障碍，而逆转录体是这一系统的关键调控节点。增强逆转录体功能在动物模型中可改善蛋白质清除、线粒体功能、神经传递并减轻神经炎症。文章还讨论了一类新型逆转录体增强剂作为潜在疾病修饰策略的前景与挑战。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS置于AD和PD共享的ELS功能障碍框架中，提出逆转录体作为跨疾病的核心调控节点。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：VPS35等逆转录体亚基的遗传和药理学操作在ALS体内模型中显示出减缓疾病进展的潜力，且逆转录体增强剂代表了一类可能同时靶向蛋白质稳态、线粒体、神经传递和神经炎症的多效性策略。但需注意，目前证据主要来自临床前模型，靶向逆转录体的脱靶效应和治疗窗口仍是关键未解问题。

aiRead.keyFinding: 逆转录体调控ALS、AD和PD共享的蛋白质稳态、线粒体功能、神经传递和神经炎症机制；在PD和ALS体内模型中，逆转录体增强剂可减缓疾病进展。
aiRead.limitation: 证据主要来自体外和动物模型，缺乏临床数据；逆转录体增强的脱靶效应、治疗窗口和长期安全性尚不明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注逆转录体增强剂在ALS模型中的进一步临床前验证、VPS35靶向策略的特异性优化，以及是否推进至早期临床试验。

items.abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是以内体-溶酶体系统（ELS）功能障碍为特征的神经退行性疾病。ALS、PD和AD中共有的四种神经退行性机制受ELS调控，即蛋白质稳态及相关蛋白质错误折叠、线粒体功能、神经传递和神经炎症。这些机制相互关联，以“滚雪球”方式促进神经退行性变。逆转录体是一种多聚体、进化上保守的蛋白质复合物，参与细胞内蛋白质运输，处于这些神经退行性过程的交叉路口。本叙述性综述聚焦于探索逆转录体的结构、作为ELS主调控因子的功能，以及这如何影响神经退行性疾病中的蛋白质稳态、线粒体生物发生和稳态、神经传递和神经炎症。我们探讨逆转录体功能的改变如何在神经退行性变中发挥重要作用，并讨论VPS35（逆转录体主要亚基之一）遗传和药理学操作的影响。体外和体内研究已发现，逆转录体通过ELS增强蛋白质降解途径的活性，即巨自噬、分子伴侣介导的自噬和ELS本身，同时减少错误折叠蛋白质水平。此外，在一些模型系统中，当逆转录体作用被增强或恢复时，线粒体功能得到挽救，功能障碍的神经传递得到恢复，神经炎症的破坏性效应被减弱。最后，我们强调了一类新型药理学药物增强逆转录体功能的作用，作为在PD和ALS体内模型中潜在减缓这些神经退行性疾病进展的策略。我们讨论了靶向逆转录体的挑战、当前局限性和逆转录体增强的潜在脱靶效应。总体而言，逆转录体调控神经退行性疾病中的共享机制，逆转录体增强剂可能代表AD、PD和ALS中的一种新型疾病修饰策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了逆转录体作为ALS、AD和PD共享内体-溶酶体调控节点的新近证据，并聚焦于逆转录体增强剂这一具有转化潜力的疾病修饰策略。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ~90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.evidenceLevel: 临床试验研究（多队列生物标志物诊断性能研究）
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的血源性生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了血浆中星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）携带的磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）作为ALS血源性生物标志物的诊断性能。在三个独立队列中，血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值区分ALS与健康对照的平均AUC达0.89，敏感性和特异性分别约为87%和89%。该指标有望辅助ALS诊断及TDP-43靶向试验的患者分层，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联尚待验证。
items.insight: 这是目前少有的在多个独立ALS队列中系统验证ADEV pTDP-43诊断性能的研究，其AUC和特异性数据在血源性CNS标志物中较为突出。对于ALS研究者而言，该标志物的价值不仅在于诊断，更在于其与TDP-43病理的直接关联，使其成为TDP-43靶向治疗试验中患者富集和药效学监测的潜在工具。后续需关注其在疾病模拟者中的特异性、纵向变化轨迹以及与神经丝轻链等现有标志物的头对头比较。

aiRead.limitation: 未充分评估对疾病模拟者的特异性；与疾病进展的关联尚未明确；样本量有限；需在更大队列和前瞻性设置中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注该标志物在ALS疾病模拟者中的特异性验证、纵向变化与疾病进展的关联，以及与神经丝轻链等现有血源性标志物的头对头比较研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前亟需非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表了一种有前景的中枢神经系统液体活检生物标志物。本研究评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。研究从三个ALS生物样本库/队列的全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离ADEVs。ADEVs的质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白水平以与四跨膜蛋白分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证评估诊断准确性，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应的平均敏感性和特异性分别为87%和89%；随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性及其与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步研究，但这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及用于TDP-43靶向临床试验中患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于多个独立ALS队列验证了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡磷酸化TDP-43作为血源性生物标志物的诊断性能，为TDP-43靶向临床试验的患者分层提供了具有转化潜力的新工具。

items.title: Anti-LAG-3 antibody treatment initiated after symptom onset extends survival in ALS model mice.
items.summary: Immune checkpoint molecules have emerged as regulators of microglial function in neurodegenerative diseases. We previously demonstrated that LAG-3 shapes disease-associated microglial phenotypes in ALS and that germline LAG-3 deletion in SOD1 G93A mice accelerated disease onset but extended duration, leaving survival unchanged. Here, we investigated the therapeutic efficacy of anti-LAG-3 antibody treatment starting after symptom onset. Anti-LAG-3 treatment extended survival, slowed neurological and motor decline, preserved body weight and motor neurons, and reduced microgliosis. Within microglia, the Axl + phagocytic-module fraction increased while the Dectin-1 + inflammatory-module fraction decreased. These findings indicate that post-onset LAG-3 inhibition is a promising therapeutic strategy for ALS.
items.titleZh: 症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗可延长ALS模型小鼠的生存期
items.summaryZh: 该研究在ALS模型小鼠中测试了症状出现后才开始使用抗LAG-3抗体治疗的效果。结果显示，治疗可延长生存期、减缓神经与运动功能下降、保护体重和运动神经元、减轻小胶质细胞增生，并促使小胶质细胞从炎症表型向吞噬表型转变。研究提示，症状出现后抑制LAG-3可能具有治疗潜力，但目前仍属于动物实验阶段。
items.insight: 这项研究值得ALS研究者跟踪，因为它把LAG-3从既往的遗传学证据推进到症状出现后干预的动物治疗实验，直接回应了临床相关时间窗问题。其观察到的生存期延长、运动神经元保护以及小胶质细胞表型向吞噬模块偏移，为免疫检查点抑制在ALS中的转化提供了可检验的机制假说和后续开发依据。

aiRead.studyType: 动物实验（SOD1 G93A ALS模型小鼠，症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗）
aiRead.keyFinding: 症状出现后给予抗LAG-3抗体可延长生存期、减缓神经与运动功能衰退、保护体重和运动神经元、减少小胶质细胞增生，并使小胶质细胞Axl+吞噬模块增加、Dectin-1+炎症模块减少。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1 G93A小鼠模型，尚不能直接推断人类ALS患者的疗效或安全性；抗体治疗的具体剂量、给药方案和长期效应仍需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注抗LAG-3治疗在其他ALS模型中的可重复性、与现有疗法的联合效果，以及是否推进到临床前毒理和早期临床试验。

items.abstractZh: 免疫检查点分子已成为神经退行性疾病中小胶质细胞功能的调节因子。我们此前证明，LAG-3塑造了ALS中疾病相关的小胶质细胞表型，并且SOD1 G93A小鼠的生殖系LAG-3缺失加速了疾病发作，但延长了持续时间，使生存期保持不变。在此，我们研究了症状出现后启动抗LAG-3抗体治疗的治疗效果。抗LAG-3治疗延长了生存期，减缓了神经和运动功能衰退，保持了体重和运动神经元，并减少了小胶质细胞增生。在小胶质细胞内，Axl+吞噬模块比例增加，而Dectin-1+炎症模块比例减少。这些发现表明，症状出现后抑制LAG-3是一种有前景的ALS治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近证明症状出现后抑制LAG-3可在ALS模型小鼠中延长生存期并调节小胶质细胞表型，具有明确的ALS相关性和免疫治疗转化价值。

items.title: Non-invasive brain stimulation in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of transcranial direct current stimulation and transcranial magnetic stimulation.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with limited disease-modifying treatments. Noninvasive brain stimulation techniques have been investigated as potential neuromodulatory interventions targeting cortical hyperexcitability in ALS. To systematically evaluate the clinical efficacy, neurophysiological effects, and safety of tDCS and TMS-based interventions in ALS. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted following PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library were searched from inception to March 2026. Thirty studies involving ALS patients were included. Pooled analyses showed no significant difference between active stimulation and sham in ALSFRS-R at 6 months (MD = 0.58, 95% CI - 0.16 to 1.31) or at end of follow-up (MD = 0.20, 95% CI - 0.49 to 0.89). No significant effect was observed for manual muscle testing. Considerable heterogeneity was noted across studies. However, several studies demonstrated modulation of cortical excitability and intracortical inhibitory circuits, particularly with repeated stimulation protocols. Both tDCS and TMS were consistently safe and well tolerated, with no serious adverse events reported. Noninvasive brain stimulation in ALS does not significantly improve functional outcomes, but induces measurable neurophysiological changes with a strong safety profile. Further studies should optimize protocols and identify responsive subgroups. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive disease that damages the nerve cells responsible for controlling muscles. As the disease advances, people gradually lose the ability to move, speak, swallow, and breathe. Current treatments provide only limited benefits, so researchers continue to explore new approaches that may help slow disease progression or improve quality of life. This study reviewed and analyzed published research on two noninvasive brain stimulation techniques: transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). These techniques use electrical or magnetic stimulation applied through the scalp to influence brain activity. Researchers have proposed that they may help reduce abnormal brain activity that is thought to contribute to ALS. We identified 30 studies that evaluated these techniques in people with ALS. When the results of comparable studies were combined, neither tDCS nor TMS showed a significant improvement in overall functional ability or muscle strength compared with sham (placebo) stimulation. However, several studies reported changes in measures of brain activity, suggesting that these techniques can influence the nervous system in meaningful ways. Importantly, both tDCS and TMS were generally safe and well tolerated, with only mild and temporary side effects such as tingling, itching, or discomfort. Overall, current evidence suggests that noninvasive brain stimulation is safe but does not yet provide clear evidence of improving disease progression or physical function in ALS. Future research should focus on optimizing stimulation methods, identifying which patients may benefit most, and determining whether these techniques could be used alongside other treatments.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中的无创脑刺激：经颅直流电刺激与经颅磁刺激的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述与荟萃分析纳入30项ALS研究，评估tDCS和TMS的疗效与安全性。汇总结果显示，与假刺激相比，两种技术均未显著改善ALSFRS-R评分或肌力，但多项研究报告了皮质兴奋性和抑制环路的神经生理调节。两种技术安全性良好，无严重不良事件。作者建议未来优化刺激方案并识别可能获益的亚组患者。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS无创脑刺激领域提供了迄今较全面的疗效与安全性汇总证据，明确了当前tDCS和TMS在功能结局上缺乏显著获益，但保留了神经生理调节信号。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示未来试验应转向生物标志物驱动的亚组筛选和方案优化，而非继续在未选择人群中重复阴性结局。

aiRead.keyFinding: tDCS和TMS在ALS中未显著改善ALSFRS-R或肌力，但可调节皮质兴奋性和皮质内抑制回路，且安全性良好。
aiRead.limitation: 纳入研究间存在相当大的异质性，可能影响汇总效应的解释；且多数研究样本量有限，随访时间不一。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展以神经生理标志物或特定亚组为入选标准、优化刺激参数的随机对照试验，以及无创脑刺激与其他治疗联合应用的探索。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，疾病修饰治疗手段有限。无创脑刺激技术已被研究作为针对ALS皮质高兴奋性的潜在神经调控干预措施。旨在系统评价tDCS和基于TMS的干预措施在ALS中的临床疗效、神经生理效应及安全性。按照PRISMA指南进行了系统综述与荟萃分析。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library，检索时间自建库至2026年3月。共纳入30项涉及ALS患者的研究。汇总分析显示，在6个月时（MD = 0.58，95% CI -0.16至1.31）或随访结束时（MD = 0.20，95% CI -0.49至0.89），活性刺激与假刺激在ALSFRS-R方面无显著差异。手动肌肉测试未观察到显著效应。研究间存在相当大的异质性。然而，多项研究显示皮质兴奋性和皮质内抑制回路受到调节，尤其是在重复刺激方案中。tDCS和TMS均 consistently 安全且耐受性良好，未报告严重不良事件。ALS中的无创脑刺激不能显著改善功能结局，但可诱导可测量的神经生理变化，且安全性良好。进一步研究应优化方案并识别应答亚组。肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性疾病，会损害控制肌肉的神经细胞。随着疾病进展，患者逐渐丧失移动、说话、吞咽和呼吸的能力。当前治疗仅提供有限获益，因此研究人员继续探索可能有助于减缓疾病进展或改善生活质量的新方法。本研究回顾并分析了关于两种无创脑刺激技术的已发表研究：经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。这些技术通过头皮施加电刺激或磁刺激来影响脑活动。研究人员提出，它们可能有助于减少被认为参与ALS发病的异常脑活动。我们识别了30项在ALS患者中评估这些技术的研究。当合并可比研究的结果时，tDCS和TMS均未显示与假（安慰剂）刺激相比在整体功能能力或肌力方面有显著改善。然而，多项研究报告了脑活动指标的变化，提示这些技术能够以有意义的方式影响神经系统。重要的是，tDCS和TMS总体安全且耐受性良好，仅出现轻微和暂时的副作用，如刺痛、瘙痒或不适。总体而言，当前证据提示无创脑刺激是安全的，但尚未提供明确证据表明其可改善ALS的疾病进展或身体功能。未来研究应聚焦于优化刺激方法、识别哪些患者可能获益最大，以及确定这些技术是否可与其他治疗联合使用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，系统汇总了ALS无创脑刺激的最新证据，明确了神经生理调节信号与功能结局阴性之间的转化差距，对优化未来ALS神经调控试验设计具有直接指导价值。

items.title: Innovative therapies under clinical development for ALS treatment. Part 2: biologics and natural products.
items.summary: The clinical trial landscape for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is rapidly expanding despite ongoing translational challenges. Following our 2022 analysis and as a continuation of Part 1, which focused on small molecules, this review provides a structured overview of biologics and natural products in the ALS clinical pipeline. Particular emphasis is placed on candidates that entered, advanced through, or completed clinical evaluation between 2022 and the end of 2025. Clinical trials for ALS registered in the United States (ClinicalTrials.gov) and the European Union (EU Clinical Trials Register/CTIS) were systematically reviewed and are summarized in this report. Modern biotechnology, ethnopharmacology, and classical pharmacology are increasingly converging in ALS therapeutic development, making this one of the most active areas of neurodegenerative disease research. Nevertheless, major challenges remain, including central nervous system (CNS) penetration, long-term safety, interpatient variability, limited clinical evidence, and the need for reliable biomarkers. Emerging technologies, such as big data analytics and artificial intelligence, may help accelerate and optimize therapeutic development, as well as improve patient recruitment and stratification.

items.titleZh: ALS治疗中处于临床开发阶段的创新疗法。第2部分：生物制品与天然产物
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了2022年至2025年底期间在美国和欧盟注册的、针对ALS的生物制品和天然产物类候选疗法的临床试验情况。文章指出，生物技术、民族药理学与经典药理学正在融合，使ALS治疗开发成为神经退行性疾病研究中最活跃的领域之一。但该领域仍面临CNS穿透性差、长期安全性不明、患者间差异大、临床证据有限和缺乏可靠生物标志物等挑战。大数据与人工智能有望加速开发并改善患者招募与分层。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了一份截至2025年底的生物制品与天然产物临床试验全景图，有助于快速了解除小分子之外的治疗管线布局、哪些候选药物已进入或完成临床评价，以及当前转化瓶颈（如CNS穿透、生物标志物缺乏）在生物制品和天然产物中的具体表现，从而为选题、合作和试验设计提供参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: 2022年至2025年底期间，ALS生物制品和天然产物临床管线活跃，生物技术、民族药理学与经典药理学日益融合，但CNS穿透、长期安全性、患者间变异性、临床证据有限和生物标志物缺乏仍是主要挑战。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，本文不提供新的原始临床数据或疗效结论；其总结基于注册信息，可能受注册信息完整性和更新延迟的限制。

items.abstractZh: 尽管转化研究仍面临持续挑战，肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的临床试验格局正在迅速扩大。继我们2022年的分析之后，并作为聚焦小分子的第1部分的延续，本综述对ALS临床研发管线中的生物制品和天然产物进行了结构化概述。重点关注在2022年至2025年底期间进入临床评价、在临床评价中取得进展或完成临床评价的候选药物。本报告系统回顾并总结了在美国（ClinicalTrials.gov）和欧盟（EU Clinical Trials Register/CTIS）注册的ALS临床试验。现代生物技术、民族药理学和经典药理学在ALS治疗开发中日益融合，使其成为神经退行性疾病研究中最为活跃的领域之一。然而，重大挑战依然存在，包括中枢神经系统（CNS）穿透性、长期安全性、患者间变异性、有限的临床证据以及对可靠生物标志物的需求。大数据分析和人工智能等新兴技术可能有助于加速和优化治疗开发，并改善患者招募和分层。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦2022年至2025年底ALS生物制品与天然产物的最新临床管线，并指出AI与大数据等新兴技术可能加速转化，对跟踪ALS治疗前沿具有参考价值。

items.title: Conceptualizing cognition and behaviour across amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia.
items.summary: Cognitive and behavioral dysfunction in frontotemporal dementia (FTD) evolves along a clinical continuum from a clinically silent stage of disease, through a prodromal period, often referred to as mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and/or mild behavioral impairment (MBI), and into a clinically manifest stage recognized by the syndromes of behavioral variant FTD and primary progressive aphasia (PPA). Similar cognitive and behavioral manifestations of varying severity are also encountered in individuals with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Notwithstanding this phenotypic overlap as well as a degree of shared genetic risk and underlying pathology, the approach to phenotypic characterization and description meaningfully differs between the ALS and FTD communities. The problem is particularly evident within the ALS community when describing impairment in the prodromal vs. clinically manifest disease stages. Pertinent considerations include the nature of cognitive and behavioral assessments, the nosology used to describe symptoms identified including those encompassed by the terms 'behavioral' and 'neuropsychiatric', the operationalized criteria that define prodromal syndromes and clinically manifest disease, and the extent to which these criteria rely on longitudinal (vs. cross-sectional) data. A multi-stakeholder workshop, held in London, Ontario (May 12-14, 2025), brought together neurologists, psychiatrists, neuropsychologists, neuropathologists, neuroscientists, and neurogeneticists studying ALS and FTD, to promote inter-disciplinary dialogue and to define a research agenda that might be jointly tackled to address these critical issues. A new nosology for classifying frontotemporal-related behavioral and neuropsychiatric dysfunction, which could be used to support empirical evidence collection, is proposed alongside a list of cognitive, language, behavioral and neuropsychiatric symptoms to be considered in the evaluation of individuals with ALS. Research priorities for each of the ALS and FTD communities, as well as initiatives that should be undertaken jointly, are highlighted. The long-term goal is to harmonize approaches to phenotypic characterization, the nosology used to describe symptoms, and the criteria used to define landmark stages along the clinical continua of the motor neuron and frontotemporal axes irrespective of clinical stage.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化与额颞叶痴呆中认知和行为的统一概念化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇来自2025年伦敦（安大略）多学科研讨会的共识性论文，旨在统一ALS和FTD中认知与行为障碍的表型描述、疾病分类和分期标准。文章指出，尽管ALS和FTD在认知行为表型、遗传风险和病理上存在重叠，但两个领域在评估工具、症状命名和操作性诊断标准上各行其是，尤其在区分前驱期与临床显现阶段时问题突出。作者提出了一套新的额颞叶相关行为和神经精神功能障碍分类体系，并给出了ALS评估中应关注的认知、语言、行为和神经精神症状清单，同时列出了各自领域及联合研究议程。
items.insight: 该文直面ALS领域长期存在的认知行为表型异质性难题，提出统一分类框架和评估清单，有望为ALS临床试验中的认知行为终点选择、患者分层和前驱期识别提供共识基础。对于关注ALS表型异质性、生物标志物与临床分期对应关系的研究者，这是一份重要的方法学参考。

items.abstractZh: 额颞叶痴呆（FTD）中的认知和行为功能障碍沿着一个临床连续谱演变：从临床静默期，经过常被称为轻度认知障碍（MCI）和/或轻度行为损害（MBI）的前驱期，进入以行为变异型FTD和原发性进行性失语（PPA）综合征为标志的临床显现阶段。在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者中也会遇到严重程度不等的类似认知和行为表现。尽管存在这种表型重叠以及一定程度的共享遗传风险和潜在病理，ALS和FTD学界在表型特征描述和定义方法上存在显著差异。这一问题在ALS学界描述前驱期与临床显现阶段损害时尤为突出。相关考量包括：认知和行为评估的性质、用于描述所识别症状（包括'行为'和'神经精神'术语所涵盖的症状）的疾病分类学、定义前驱综合征和临床显性疾病的操作性标准，以及这些标准对纵向（而非横断面）数据的依赖程度。2025年5月12日至14日在加拿大安大略省伦敦市举行的一次多方利益相关者研讨会，汇集了研究ALS和FTD的神经病学家、精神病学家、神经心理学家、神经病理学家、神经科学家和神经遗传学家，以促进跨学科对话并确定可共同应对这些关键问题的研究议程。本文提出了一种用于分类额颞叶相关行为和神经精神功能障碍的新疾病分类学，可用于支持实证证据收集，同时提出了一份在ALS患者评估中应考虑的认知、语言、行为和神经精神症状清单。文中强调了ALS和FTD各自学界的研究优先事项，以及应联合开展的举措。长期目标是统一表型特征描述方法、用于描述症状的疾病分类学，以及用于定义运动神经元轴和额颞叶轴临床连续谱上标志性阶段的标准，而不论临床阶段如何。
items.frontierRationale: 该文基于2025年最新多学科研讨会，提出ALS与FTD认知行为表型统一分类框架，直接回应ALS临床试验中认知行为评估标准不一致的转化瓶颈。

items.title: Dysregulated microRNA-mRNA networks in SOD1G93A mouse skeletal muscle reveal metabolic impairments in ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a multi-system disease in which skeletal muscle actively contributes to pathology, yet the regulatory circuits that drive muscle dysfunction remain unclear. We examined microRNA (miRNA)-messenger RNA (mRNA) interactions in the gastrocnemius of hSOD1G93A mice across presymptomatic, early- and late-symptomatic stages, using RNA-seq, bioinformatics, and RT-qPCR. Compared with hSOD1WT and non-transgenic controls, hSOD1G93A muscle showed mutation-specific transcriptome reprogramming: 48 dysregulated miRNAs and 558 mRNAs at presymptomatic, and 64 miRNAs and 685 mRNAs at late-symptomatic stages. Functional enrichment pinpointed carbohydrate-handling pathways (glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, pentose-phosphate, fructose-mannose metabolism) as the dominant downregulated gene sets. Network analysis revealed clusters in which upregulated miRNAs converged on, and showed inverse expression patterns relative to metabolic transcripts. RT-qPCR confirmed inverse expression of 10 candidate miRNAs and 11 metabolic mRNAs, substantiating miRNA-guided repression of glycolytic enzymes and energy-sensing nodes. Collectively, we show that SOD1G93A drives an early, sustained miRNA signature that dampens glycolysis gene expression, which could promote the fast-to-slow fibre-type transition and exacerbate energy deficit in ALS muscle. Targeting these circuits offers a strategy to restore metabolic balance and slow disease progression.
items.titleZh: SOD1G93A小鼠骨骼肌中失调的microRNA-mRNA网络揭示ALS代谢损伤
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1G93A ALS小鼠模型中，通过多阶段转录组分析发现骨骼肌存在突变特异性的miRNA-mRNA调控网络失调，主要表现为糖酵解等碳水化合物代谢通路基因被上调的miRNA抑制，且这一特征在症状出现前即已存在。研究提示肌肉代谢障碍是ALS早期事件，靶向相关miRNA回路可能有助于恢复能量平衡。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS骨骼肌从被动受累组织提升为主动参与病理的代谢调控节点，并提供了从症状前到晚期的时间序列miRNA-mRNA网络数据。对于关注ALS外周机制、生物标志物或代谢干预的研究者，该工作提示肌肉特异性miRNA可作为早期干预靶点，并值得在人类ALS肌肉活检或体液样本中验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种多系统疾病，其中骨骼肌主动参与病理过程，但驱动肌肉功能障碍的调控回路仍不清楚。我们使用RNA-seq、生物信息学和RT-qPCR，检测了hSOD1G93A小鼠腓肠肌在症状前、早期症状和晚期症状阶段的microRNA（miRNA）-信使RNA（mRNA）相互作用。与hSOD1WT和非转基因对照相比，hSOD1G93A肌肉显示出突变特异性转录组重编程：症状前阶段有48个失调miRNA和558个mRNA，晚期症状阶段有64个miRNA和685个mRNA。功能富集指出碳水化合物处理通路（糖酵解/糖异生、磷酸戊糖途径、果糖-甘露糖代谢）是主要下调的基因集。网络分析揭示了上调miRNA汇聚的簇，并相对于代谢转录本表现出反向表达模式。RT-qPCR证实了10个候选miRNA和11个代谢mRNA的反向表达，证实了miRNA引导的糖酵解酶和能量感应节点的抑制。总之，我们表明SOD1G93A驱动一个早期、持续的miRNA特征，抑制糖酵解基因表达，这可能促进快肌向慢肌纤维类型转变并加剧ALS肌肉中的能量缺陷。靶向这些回路提供了恢复代谢平衡和减缓疾病进展的策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用SOD1G93A小鼠多阶段转录组数据，新近揭示了ALS骨骼肌中miRNA介导的糖酵解抑制网络，为靶向肌肉代谢的转化策略提供了临床前依据。

items.title: The role of overdose folic acid in promoting neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in SOD1-G93A mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative condition that involves the targeted degeneration of motor neurons. The precise pathogenetic mechanisms are still largely unclear. In this study, we utilized the SOD1-G93A mouse model of ALS to investigate the effects of folic acid (FA), an important factor involved in homocysteine metabolism. Our results indicated that a little FA prolonged the lifespan of the SOD1-G93A mice and medium and high-dose FA significantly shortened the lifespan of the SOD1-G93A mice. Furthermore, we observed that an overdose of FA significantly elevated inflammation levels in the cerebellum, as evidenced by increased concentrations of tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), interleukin-1β (IL-1β), cluster of differentiation 68 (CD68), cluster of differentiation 86 (CD86), and monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1), facilitating microglial activation. The low-dose FA effects were the opposite of the overdose FA. Additionally, high-dose FA increased the levels of phosphorylated p65 (p-p65)/p65, thereby promoting the NF-κB signaling pathway. Conversely, high-dose FA inhibited the expression of total superoxide dismutase (T-SOD) while increasing the level of malondialdehyde (MDA) in the cerebellum; these effects were not observed in muscle tissue. Moreover, high-dose FA elevated the levels of Bax2/Bcl-2. Concurrently, high-dose FA induced increased apoptosis in SOD1-G93A mice, as demonstrated by TUNEL staining. Notably, the brain iron content of SOD1-G93A mice remained unchanged following FA treatment. These findings provide evidence that an overdose of FA supplementation may exert pro-inflammatory effects by promoting the NF-κB pathway, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in the context of ALS.
items.titleZh: 过量叶酸在SOD1-G93A小鼠中促进神经炎症、氧化应激和细胞凋亡的作用
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现叶酸存在剂量双相效应：低剂量延长寿命，中高剂量反而缩短寿命。过量叶酸可激活小脑小胶质细胞、升高TNF-α、IL-1β、CD68、CD86、MCP-1等炎症标志物，经NF-κB通路促进神经炎症，同时抑制T-SOD、升高MDA造成氧化应激，并上调Bax2/Bcl-2诱导凋亡。脑铁含量未受影响。提示ALS患者补充叶酸需关注剂量，过量可能有害。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS中一个常见且易被忽视的补充剂——叶酸——提供了剂量依赖性的临床前安全性信号。其价值在于：一方面提示ALS患者盲目高剂量补充叶酸可能通过NF-κB介导的神经炎症和氧化应激加速疾病进展；另一方面也提示叶酸代谢通路（同型半胱氨酸代谢）可能是ALS中可干预的微环境因素。对关注SOD1-G93A模型、神经炎症机制及营养干预安全性的研究者具有参考意义。

aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，不能直接外推至人类ALS；未明确叶酸剂量与人类膳食/补充剂量的对应关系；机制验证以相关性指标为主，缺乏NF-κB通路的直接干预实验。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种涉及运动神经元靶向性退变的神经退行性疾病。其确切的发病机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。本研究利用ALS的SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，探讨叶酸（FA）——一种参与同型半胱氨酸代谢的重要因素——的影响。我们的结果表明，少量叶酸可延长SOD1-G93A小鼠的寿命，而中剂量和高剂量叶酸则显著缩短SOD1-G93A小鼠的寿命。此外，我们观察到过量叶酸显著升高小脑中的炎症水平，表现为肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、分化簇68（CD68）、分化簇86（CD86）和单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）浓度升高，促进小胶质细胞活化。低剂量叶酸的作用与过量叶酸相反。此外，高剂量叶酸升高磷酸化p65（p-p65）/p65水平，从而促进NF-κB信号通路。相反，高剂量叶酸抑制小脑中总超氧化物歧化酶（T-SOD）的表达，同时升高丙二醛（MDA）水平；这些效应在肌肉组织中未观察到。此外，高剂量叶酸升高Bax2/Bcl-2水平。同时，高剂量叶酸诱导SOD1-G93A小鼠细胞凋亡增加，如TUNEL染色所示。值得注意的是，叶酸处理后SOD1-G93A小鼠的脑铁含量保持不变。这些发现提供证据表明，在ALS背景下，过量叶酸补充可能通过促进NF-κB通路、氧化应激和细胞凋亡而发挥促炎作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了叶酸在ALS小鼠模型中剂量依赖的双相效应，直接关联SOD1-G93A这一经典ALS模型，并提示营养补充剂过量可能通过NF-κB炎症通路产生转化风险。
